columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: The registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token.
columns.method: The firm scope of the custody entry the silver partition is read under, taken from the registry.

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: The account key carried by the silver row. It is an identifier and is not reproduced in any report.

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: The silver partition's business date, the date= partition the row is written under.

columns.name: trade_date
columns.meaning: The trade_date column of fact_trn, which the lot source reads; null when the silver row carries none.

columns.name: settle_date
columns.meaning: The settlement date. No silver column supplies it (round-123 ground read), so the column is null.

columns.name: action
columns.meaning: The action word of the row: the txn_type's action through type_action. Null only when the code is not in the mapping.
columns.method: From txn_type through type_action (the type word to its action word).

columns.name: txn_type
columns.meaning: The ratified type word of the row, or the string UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.
columns.method: From tran_srcde through source_mapping (the 49 Financial code to its ratified type word); UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.

columns.name: symbol
columns.meaning: The security symbol, the ticker_symbol column; null on a row with no security.

columns.name: asset_name
columns.meaning: The security's name. No silver column supplies it, so the column is null.

columns.name: units
columns.meaning: The quantity column (quantity); null when the row carries none.

columns.name: price
columns.meaning: The price column; null when the row carries none.

columns.name: amount
columns.meaning: The custodian's gross money amount (gross_amount). On a cash row the sign is taken from debit_credit as account_return_daily.py takes it: CREDIT positive, DEBIT negative. On an in-kind row debit_credit is a position side and is not read as a cash sign.

columns.name: fee
columns.meaning: The fee column. The fee rail is unused by design, so no silver column supplies it and the column is null.

columns.name: custodian
columns.meaning: The custodian of the row, the constant of the custody entry.
columns.method: The custodian constant of the custody entry the silver partition is read under, set once per entry in the registry.

columns.name: flow_class
columns.meaning: The flow class of the row's tran_srcde: EXTERNAL_IN, EXTERNAL_OUT, INCOME, FEE, INTERNAL, CORPORATE_ACTION or UNRESOLVED.
columns.method: Per tran_srcde through flow_class_rule over the CRO table's (partition, rule) pairs: one class when the code's CRO rows agree, UNRESOLVED when they disagree or the table does not hold the code. The silver-only codes and IRAWH and MCE are fixed in source_mapping.

columns.name: source_txn_id
columns.meaning: A per-transaction identifier. None is read: order_number is an order-level id and is not used, so the column is null.

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: How the row's code is covered by the mapping: MEASURED, CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING or UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE.
columns.method: MEASURED when the code maps to a type word; CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING when the mapping lacks the code; UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED.

flow_class_rule.reason: An account transfer is internal only when its counterparty leg is matched, and the line does not carry the counterparty.
A journal is internal or external by its counterparty, which the line does not carry.
A share delivery is internal when its other leg sits in a sister account, and the line does not state which.
A classified check's direction is not stated by the rule, so it cannot be classed until a specimen is read.
A returned deposit reverses a deposit whose direction the rule does not state, so the table does not settle its class.
The partition is money entering the account from outside the firm.
The partition is money leaving the account to outside it, and an IRA withholding is paid out of the account.
A check paid out of the account leaves the account to a payee outside it.
A withdrawal moves cash or securities from the account to outside the firm.
An administrative fee charged to the account is a fee whatever its label.
A service fee charged to the account is a fee.
An explicit advisor fee debited from the account is a management fee, which is a fee.
An advisory fee debited from the account is a fee.
A verified advisor fee is a fee against the fee record.
Alternative income is income earned inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition, which the return engine treats as inside the account.
A cash-in-lieu payment for a fractional share is a corporate action inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A corporate action on a holding is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A corporate action on an in-kind position is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A miscellaneous corporate action is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A dividend is income earned by the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A foreign tax withheld on income is taken inside the account, so it stays an INTERNAL movement.
An interest adjustment is income inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
Interest is income earned by the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A reinvestment moves income back into the account, an INTERNAL movement.
A sweep moves cash between the account's own holdings, an INTERNAL movement.
A trade moves value between cash and a position inside the account, an INTERNAL movement.
A withholding taken inside the account is an INTERNAL movement.
The table holds no rule for the line, so its class is the table's own unresolved state.
A lending or miscellaneous in-kind line cannot be classed until a specimen shows its direction.
A miscellaneous adjustment's cash direction is not stated by the table, so it stays UNRESOLVED until a specimen is read.

source_mapping.reason: Two rows with two meanings: the FC row (rule misc-adj, FUNDS ADJUSTMENT) is a cash funds adjustment, and the IC row (rule corp-actions-ic, POSITION ADJ) is a security position adjustment. They take different words (Adjustment and Corporate action), so the table gives this code no single meaning.
Rule misc-adj with a generic description (MISC ADJUSTMENT); the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.
Rule checks-classified with the description SCHWAB CHECK; the same description is a deposit on one code and a paid check on another, and this row states neither direction, so no single word fits.
Rule cash-in-lieu; a cash payment for a fractional share. The table does not say whether a sale of the fraction or a corporate-action payment, so no single word fits.
Rule cash-in-lieu; a cash payment for a fractional share. The table does not say whether a sale of the fraction or a corporate-action payment, so no single word fits.
Rule misc-adj with no description; the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.
Rule misc-adj with no description; the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.

Silver-only code (not in the CRO table). The description carries the word MATURED, a security that matured. Corporate action names expiry as the issuer-side end of a holding, and a maturity is that end, so Corporate action.
Rule corp-misc with the description Litigation; the table does not say whether a settlement is income, a return of cost or a correction, so no single word fits.

Rules deposits and withdrawals under one description, MONEYLINK TRANSFER: one row is an inflow and one an outflow. The description does not give the direction, so the table gives this code no single meaning.
Rules returned-deposits, deposits and withdrawals under one empty description: the rows run in both directions. The table gives this code no single meaning.
Rule corp-misc with the description CREDIT PRO and category Dividends and Interest. The description does not say whether the credit is income or a correction, so no single word fits.
Rule no-rule with no description; the table does not say whether cash moves, and the Adjustment word is defined with no cash flow.

Silver-only code (not in the CRO table). The description carries the words PARTIAL CALL, a bond partial redemption: the same issuer redemption event as the table's REDEMP/CONVERSION codes, so Corporate action.

Silver-only code (not in the CRO table). The description carries an issuer name and no transaction word, and the AJ ending is not a basis for a meaning (the record decides on the description, never on a sub-code or a suffix), so the table and the silver give no single meaning here.

Rule deposits with the description Stop Check Payment. A stop credits back a check that was paid, a reversal of an earlier withdrawal, not an inflow from outside; the rule and the description disagree and no single word fits.

Rule deposits with the description Voided Check. A voided check credits back a check that was paid, a reversal of an earlier withdrawal, not an inflow from outside; the rule and the description disagree and no single word fits.
Rule lending-misc-ic with no description; securities lending income and a lending return cannot be told apart from the table, so no single word fits.
Internal bucket, but the yaml calls it a synthetic per-position opening seed, not a transaction a client made.
Internal bucket, but the yaml says Remark is a position seed only where a ticker is present and a cash-shaped Remark fails loud to UNRESOLVED; its meaning depends on the row shape.
